description: What a change touches, for choosing how much to verify while iterating. Read by harness/scope.py and by the planner. Every shared prefix says why: a change there can break screens it does not mention.

shared.why: DI container and query client: every screen resolves through it
entities and repository contracts used by every layer
colour and spacing tokens used by every screen
routes and params of every screen
query keys shared by hooks and screens
agents and hooks: the gate also checks these

native.why: Swift, plist, Xcode project, Podfile: compiled into the binary
Kotlin, Gradle, manifest: compiled into the binary
dependencies can ship native code (React Native itself does)
